title: Unreal Engine 5.9 MegaJam Preview Announced
author: Recoil42
selftext:
*We’ve been accumulating changes for rendering and animation in UE5 Main for an eventual 5.9 release next year. However, just a week ago, we decided to start working on a UE 5.9 Preview in time for the 2026 Epic AI MegaJam on November 12–15.*

*This UE 5.9 MegaJam Preview is the first Unreal Engine release built primarily with agentic workflows. A handful of people directed fleets of agents to port the AI tooling from our UE6 development branch and implement Web as a target platform. Agents wrote the web platform code, starting from UE4’s retired HTML5 platform, with engineers directing, reviewing, and testing the work.*

*We’re using this release to learn how to build the engine with multiple people directing swarms of agents working in parallel… and we still have lots to learn. Having said that, we’re already seeing benefits from this approach, and it allows us to deliver more UE5 releases with faster bug fixes and development on targeted features, all without pulling focus from UE6.*

*This Preview had about a week of development and a shorter QA pass than usual. We’re still cleaning up some of the agent-written code, and parts of the web renderer are prototypes we plan to refactor before the full 5.9 release ships. As with all Previews, expect rough edges, missing pieces, and things that break.*

*Test it out during the Epic AI MegaJam or on a copy of your project and tell us what bugs you find: we’ll be fixing issues throughout the preview period, with agents helping us triage and turn reports around quickly.*
